attBesluta.text: Works great in the spray booth. STRONG magnets. Hold small parts easily and allows one to use both hands(!) Arrived with a piece missing and some scratched parts. Vevors customer service was awesome at making good on proper parts!!! Great accessory purchase.
Quickly delivered, good strong material and construction. Excellent way to keep my bike safe from rain and bad weather

Bonjour, je viens juste de le monter et l ensemble me semble correct à l exception dans mon cas que les chevilles béton vont être trop courte car je dois atteindre la couche de béton, les dalles trop anciennes ne résisteront pas! Des fixations chevilles béton plus longues me seront donc nécessaires. Ce n’est pas votre faute bien sûr! mais je pense que d autres clients feront la même constatation. Bien à vous sincères salutations Gillet Christian
Cet abri est parfait lorsqu on veut laisser sa moto à l abri des pluies passagères. Facile à monter, je l ai lesté avec des poids qui chevauchent les barres au sol. Ainsi, il ne peut pas s envoler.
Deze motorhoes is echt een uitkomst voor het netjes stallen van fietsen en nog andere spullen. Ben er erg blij mee!
Very good quality. Easy to use and store. Happy with purchase.
Love these things to support hydraulic cylinders during tear down. Seems like a great buy for the money, very easy to use and quick set up.

Well made folding stands. They are designed to hold pipes, but I have been using them to support 4 x 4 x 20‘ square steel while using the drill press. They were great. They are easy to adjust - Maybe add a bit of grease to the collar threads. I will buy them again.
Zeer functioneel bij het extra ondersteunen van lengtes. Door de wielen extra mobiel ook als de lengte pijp in de steunt leunt.

The pipe stands we purchased work exactly as expected and are of good quality. The only problem that I have with purchasing from VEVOR is that we are tax exempt and this has been documented and accepted by VEVOR but the taxes were still on the invoice and have not been refunded. I have sent emails multiple times with no response!
Wir haben diesen benutzt um unser Motorboot vom Trailer zu bringen, da dieser zum TÜV müsste. Hat super geklappt und passt gut. Sehr zu empfehlen, würde ich jederzeit wieder kaufen! 😃

Wir nutzen das für unser Boot um es vom Trailer freizugeben. Funktioniert einwandfrei und war leicht zu bedienen. Wir haben allerdings die Rollen herunter geschraubt, um von der Höhe niedriger zu werden.
Super produit et très solide et pratique avec les roulettes. Très content de mon achat je recommande cet article.

A beautiful stand, but the description 20-37 inches is wrong. The lowest position is 25.25 to the bottom of the V. I can still make it work by removing the wheels. So, sorry vevor, you lost a point because you're description person doesn't know how to measure!
The items were delivered intact and one day later than the expected date per your tracking system.

Ottimo frigo. Molto spazioso, personalmente avevo bisogno di una buona capacità di carico e questo mi è sembrato un buon compromesso capienza prezzo. Le ruote e la maniglia molto robusta consentono uno spostamento agevole anche con il pieno carico. Lo uso ormai da un anno sia in viaggio sia in casa d'estate come frigo di supporto. Unica pecca non ha un reparto freezer anche se può congelare tutto il vano ma esistono versioni a doppia zona. I consumi sono molto contenuti. Lo consiglio a chi ha bisogno di ampio spazio di carico.
Super génial, en moins de 15 mn elle est passer de 24 à -2 dégrée aucun bruit
Vielen Dank. Das hat super funktioniert. Leider gibt es KEINE Deutsche Betriebsanleitung dazu. Auch im Netz konnte ich keine bekommen. Das ist echt schade.
Facile d'utilisation, refroidissement rapide en consommation basse, très bon volume.
Macchina veramente performante fa il suo dovere senza sforzo ho applicato unativegetativa soluzione dura e non ha fatto una piega
Tool is robust but the shipping was horrible, box was totally broken and tools were bent
Bon produit, mais je suis très déçu par les transports GLS qui on endommagé le colis. Le cadre de la pompe est complètement voilé.

Have not used it yet but need it for my pool heater system. A known kvnt "borrowed" my Ridgid wrench identical to this one that was left to me by my father. I was going to replace it and was aghast at the price at over four times this VEVOR wrench and doubt it was four times as good LOL. This one seemed as durable, light and nearly as tight. If I was a tradesman (I am not) I would not hesitate to use the VEVOR tool products I have purchased thus far for friends and myself.
